_doc: Item-card contract — single canonical spec used by both platforms. The shape below is the prop set FetchCard (mobile, Flutter) and ItemRowCard (web, React) MUST implement. Each scenario describes a card configuration; the Node runner renders an HTML preview of each, the Dart test pumps each through FetchCard and asserts it builds. If both runners pass, the two implementations agree on the contract.

imageEmoji.desc: Emoji rendered in the tinted image tile when no URL.

imageUrl.desc: Product image URL. Falls back to imageEmoji on error.

tint.desc: Tile-bg color. Card body is always white.

urgency.desc: Top-of-content pill. Lightning bolt added when text contains 'left'.

urgencyBg.desc: Urgency pill background. Defaults to rose-200.

urgencyFg.desc: Urgency pill text/icon. Defaults to rose-900.

storeName.desc: Pill in the utility row — store name, on-hand, etc.

storeColor.desc: Color for the store-emoji circle in the pill.

storeEmoji.desc: Emoji or letter inside the store-pill circle.

value.desc: Right-aligned coin chip value. Formats >=1000 as 'k'.

valueIsPrefix.desc: When true, label goes BEFORE the number ('$ 42').

rating.desc: Star count to display in the utility row.

onRate.desc: Per-star tap. When null, the star row is hidden.

onToggleSave.desc: Heart-icon tap. When null, no heart shown.
